datasets.name: ODSLogs
datasets.sql:
select id, logtype, decode(logtype, 1, 'User Grants', 2, 'Modules', 3, 'Objects', 4, 'Group Man') logtp, usname, modtime, moduser, modul, cins, cupd, cdel,
       oper, decode(oper, 1,'Insert', 2,'Before Update', 3,'Delete', 4,'After Update') operat, description, trvdesc, advanced_grants, otype, ofullname,
       ophone, oclassid, ofilialid, oadvtype, osysuserid
 from sba_adm_logs

order by id desc

datasets.name: ODSModuleLogs
datasets.sql:
select id, logtype, decode(logtype, 1, 'User Grants', 2, 'Modules', 3, 'Objects', 4, 'Group Man') logtp, usname, modtime,  modul, decode(cins,0,'-',1,'+') cins, decode(cupd,0,'-',1,'+') cupd, decode(cdel,0,'-',1,'+') cdel,
       oper, decode(oper, 1,'Insert', 2,'Before Update', 3,'Delete', 4,'After Update') operat, description, trvdesc, advanced_grants from sba_adm_logs
where logtype=2



order by id desc

datasets.name: ODSUsersLogs
datasets.sql:
select l.id, logtype, decode(logtype, 1, 'User Grants', 2, 'Modules', 3, 'Objects', 4, 'Group Man') logtp,
usname, modtime, moduser,       oper, decode(oper, 1,'Insert', 2,'Before Update', 3,'Delete', 4,'After Update') operat, 
l.description, otype, ofullname,
       ophone, nvl(o.obj,'Yox') oclassid, f.name ofilialid, oadvtype, osysuserid
 from sba_adm_logs l, filial_t f, sba_objinf o
where logtype=3 and otype='U' and f.id=ofilialid and o.id(+)=oclassid
         


order by id desc

datasets.name: ODSClassesLogs
datasets.sql:
select id, logtype, decode(logtype, 1, 'User Grants', 2, 'Modules', 3, 'Objects', 4, 'Group Man') logtp, usname, modtime, moduser,
       oper, decode(oper, 1,'Insert', 2,'Before Update', 3,'Delete', 4,'After Update') operat, otype
 from sba_adm_logs
where logtype=3 and otype='C'


order by id desc

datasets.name: OdsGroupsLogs
datasets.sql:
select l.id, logtype, decode(logtype, 1, 'User Grants', 2, 'Modules', 3, 'Objects', 4, 'Group Man') logtp, usname, modtime, moduser,
       oper, decode(oper, 1,'Insert', 2,'Before Update', 3,'Delete', 4,'After Update') operat, description, otype, descr oadvtype
 from sba_adm_logs l, sba_grouptypes g
where logtype=3 and otype='G' and oadvtype=g.id


order by id desc

datasets.name: ODSUserGrantsLogs
datasets.sql:
select id, logtype, decode(logtype, 1, 'User Grants', 2, 'Modules', 3, 'Objects', 4, 'Group Man') logtp, usname, modtime, moduser, modul, decode(cins,0,'-',1,'+') cins, decode(cupd,0,'-',1,'+') cupd, decode(cdel,0,'-',1,'+') cdel,
       oper, decode(oper, 1,'Insert', 2,'Before Update', 3,'Delete', 4,'After Update') operat
 from sba_adm_logs
where logtype=1

order by id desc

datasets.name: ODSGroupManLogs
datasets.sql:
select   l.id, logtype,
         decode (logtype,
                 1, 'User Grants',
                 2, 'Modules',
                 3, 'Objects',
                 4, 'Group Man'
                ) logtp,
         usname, modtime, moduser, oper,
         decode (oper,
                 1, 'Insert',
                 2, 'Before Update',
                 3, 'Delete',
                 4, 'After Update'
                ) operat,
         advanced_grants, o.obj oclassid, decode(oadvtype,1,'Baş',2, 'Tabe',3, 'Neytral') oadvtype, oclassid grid
    from sba_adm_logs l, sba_objinf o
   where l.oclassid = o.id and logtype = 4








order by id desc

datasets.name: ODSLockedUsers
datasets.sql: select u.id, u.name from user$ u, sba_objinf o where name=obj and sb_adm.islocked_num(name)=1 order by u.name

datasets.name: ODSSLLogs
datasets.sql:
select id, logtype, decode(logtype, 1, 'Hüquqlar', 2, 'Modules', 3, 'Истифадячиляр', 4, 'Qruplar') logtp, usname, modtime, moduser,
        decode(oper, 1,'Insert', 2,'Before Update', 3,'Delete', 4,'After Update') operat from sba_adm_logs
where moduser=:moduser
